title: Nigra sum (Lhéritier)
desc: Jean Lhéritier, Nigra sum, before 1533. 5 voices (Cantus, Quinta, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0047); edited by Yoav Belinsky, Vincent Besson, Kévin Roger, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
